name: rule-triage-across-the-repository
why: Triage as a kind of work on the repository's issues, in a person's words, against the skill's policy: creating a label with no condition covers creating a triage label, and the judge is asked whether "the user the credential belongs to wrote it" is within the person's "it is a comment written by the user the credential belongs to".

statements: allow read on anything in repository $primary.repo
allow add label, remove label on issue in repository $primary.repo
allow create on label in repository $primary.repo
allow create on comment within issue in repository $primary.repo
allow update on comment within issue in repository $primary.repo when "it is a comment written by the user the credential belongs to"
deny delete, update on label in anywhere
deny delete on comment in anywhere
deny push on branch in anywhere

definitions.add label: add a label to an issue
definitions.branch: a git branch in a repository
definitions.comment: a comment or review reply on a pull request or issue
definitions.label: a label a repository's issues can carry
definitions.push: add commits to a branch, or move it with --force-with-lease
definitions.remove label: remove a label from an issue

statements: allow read on anything in repository $primary.repo
allow add label, remove label on issue in repository $primary.repo
allow create on label in repository $primary.repo when "it is a triage label"
allow create on comment within issue in repository $primary.repo
allow update on comment within issue in repository $primary.repo when "the user the credential belongs to wrote it"
deny delete, update on label in anywhere
deny close, assign, retitle on issue in anywhere
deny delete on comment in anywhere
deny push on branch in anywhere
deny read on secret in anywhere

definitions.add label: add a label to an issue
definitions.branch: a git branch in a repository
definitions.close: close a pull request or issue without merging it
definitions.comment: a comment or review reply on a pull request or issue
definitions.label: a label a repository's issues can carry
definitions.push: add commits to a branch, or move it with --force-with-lease
definitions.remove label: remove a label from an issue
definitions.retitle: change an issue's title or body
definitions.secret: an Actions, Dependabot or environment secret
